text: Assignment. I have three assignments this week.
Classmate. My classmates helped me with the timetable.
Bus pass. You need a bus pass to get to the beach.
Weekend job. A lot of students here have a weekend job.
Catch up. I have to catch up on two assignments.
Hang out. We hang out at the beach after school.
Get used to. I am getting used to the accent.
Settle in. It takes about a month to settle in.
Sorry, say that again?
Hang on, let me think.
I am still getting used to it.
So? Have you settled in yet?
Mostly. I have been here for four weeks and it feels like three months.
That is normal. What does a normal day look like now?
I get up at half past five, I surf, then I catch the bus. School until three.
You surf before school every day? Even in winter?
Every day. Well, I did not go on Tuesday, because I had two assignments to catch up on.
Fair. What are you doing this weekend?
I am going to work Saturday morning. I got a weekend job at the surf shop last week.
You have been here a month and you already have a job. Right, you have settled in.
I have been here for a month.
I have to catch up on some school work.

So, a normal week here. Monday to Friday I get up at half past five, because the good waves are before school and school starts at nine. I catch the bus at ten past eight and I use my bus pass, which my host family sorted out in the first week. At the moment I am doing an assignment on Australian history, which is due Friday, and I have not started it properly yet. Last weekend I worked at the surf shop for the first time. This weekend I am going to work again, and then I am going to sleep for about eleven hours.

Every exchange student I have met says the same thing about the first month. Week one is a holiday. Week two is horrible, and that is when most of them call home crying. Week three something switches. And by week four they have a routine and they have stopped translating everything in their head. My advice is simple. Join something in the first seven days, anything, and say yes to every invitation for a month even when you are tired. The ones who settle in fast are not the ones with the best English. They are the ones who left the house.
